insurer: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited
sumInsured: Base Sum Insured options: 3L, 4L, 5L, 7.5L, 10L, 12.5L, 15L, 20L, 25L, 50L, 75L, 100L (Individual/Family Floater); Total SI may include Booster Benefit and optional Safeguard/Safeguard+; plus ReAssure benefit

great.name: Restore Benefit (ReAssure) — unlimited reinstatement incl. same illness
great.quote: ReAssure Unlimited reinstatement up to base Sum Insured. (Applicable for both same & different illness)
great.explanation: After a claim, your Sum Insured can be replenished and used again in the same policy year, including for the same illness—this is best-in-class. (Wording also states per-claim under this benefit capped at Base Sum Insured.)

great.name: Built-in Additional Sum Insured buffer (ReAssure) after base is exhausted
great.quote: The sequence of utilization of Sum Insured will be as below: i. Base Sum Insured ... iii. Accumulated Cumulative Bonus under Booster benefit (if any) followed by; iv. ReAssure benefit
great.explanation: The policy provides an extra coverage layer (ReAssure) that becomes available after using Base SI (and other applicable layers), improving protection in multiple-claim years.

good.name: PED waiting period: 36 months
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a Pre-existing Disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first Policy .
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are covered after 3 years of continuous coverage, which is an industry-standard waiting period.

good.name: Specific illness/procedure waiting period: 24 months
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first Policy.
good.explanation: 2-year waiting period for listed diseases/procedures is standard.

good.name: Initial waiting period: 30 days (illness); accidents covered from day 1
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any Illness within 30 days from the first Policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an Accident
good.explanation: 30-day initial waiting is standard across health insurance (accidents are covered immediately).

good.name: Pre-hospitalization cover: 60 days
good.quote: We will pay above mentioned Pre-hospitalization Medical Expenses only for period up to 60 days immediately preceding the Insured Person’s admission
good.explanation: Covers eligible medical expenses for up to 60 days before hospitalization (standard-good).

good.name: Post-hospitalization cover: 180 days
good.quote: We will pay Post-hospitalization Medical Expenses only for up to 180 days immediately following the Insured Person’s discharge
good.explanation: Covers eligible medical expenses for up to 180 days after discharge (upper end of standard coverage).

bad.name: Consumables not covered (explicit non-payables list includes key consumables like gloves, mask, nebulisation kit etc.)
bad.quote:
Annexure II - The expenses that are not covered or subsumed into room charges / procedure charges / costs of treatment
List  I – Expenses not covered ... 56 GLOVES ... 60 MASK ... 57 NEBULISATION KIT ...
bad.reference: Annexure II (List I – Expenses not covered)
bad.explanation: Common consumables (e.g., gloves, masks, kits) can become out-of-pocket, which increases your hospital bill beyond what the policy reimburses.

unclear.name: Room rent limit (eligible room category) not stated in the provided text
unclear.quote: Room Rent means the amount charged by a Hospital towards Room and Boarding expenses and shall include the associated medical expenses.
unclear.reference: Section 3.1.41 (Room Rent) + Annexure I (Inpatient Care: 'Covered up to Sum Insured')
unclear.explanation: The document excerpt does not specify the default eligible room category/limit (e.g., 'Any room' vs 'Single Private AC'). Since proportionate deductions depend on the room eligibility stated in the Policy Schedule, confirm your room entitlement in the Policy Schedule.

unclear.name: Co-pay terms not explicitly stated (schedule-driven)
unclear.quote: Co-payment (if applicable) as specified in the Policy Schedule shall be applicable on the amount payable by Us.
unclear.explanation: The wording indicates co-pay may apply based on the Policy Schedule, but the actual percentage/trigger isn’t in the provided text. Verify in your Policy Schedule whether co-pay is 0% or applicable (and when).
